title: CCPA Privacy Request Letter Template - Free Download
metaDescription: Free CCPA privacy request letter template for California residents. Exercise your rights to know, delete, or opt-out under California privacy law.
description: Professional letter template to help California residents exercise their CCPA rights including data access, deletion, and opt-out requests. Includes step-by-step guidance and customizable sections for different privacy request types.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
Date: [DATE]

To: [COMPANY_NAME]
Attn: Privacy Officer / Data Protection Officer
[COMPANY_ADDRESS]

Re: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Request

Dear Sir/Madam,

sections.heading: Personal Identification
sections.content:
I am writing to exercise my rights as a California consumer under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Please find my identifying information below:

Full Name: [YOUR_NAME]
Address: [YOUR_ADDRESS]
Email: [YOUR_EMAIL]
Phone: [YOUR_PHONE]
Account Number (if applicable): [ACCOUNT_NUMBER]

sections.heading: Request Type Selection
sections.content:
I hereby request that you honor my CCPA rights as follows (check all that apply):

☐ RIGHT TO KNOW: Provide me with the specific pieces of personal information you have collected about me in the past 12 months.

☐ RIGHT TO DELETE: Delete all personal information you have collected about me.

☐ RIGHT TO OPT-OUT: Do not sell or share my personal information with third parties.

☐ RIGHT TO NON-DISCRIMINATION: Ensure I receive equal service and pricing regardless of exercising my privacy rights.

sections.heading: Detailed Request Information
sections.content:
Please provide the following information for the 12-month period preceding this request:

• Categories of personal information collected
• Sources of personal information
• Business or commercial purposes for collection
• Categories of third parties with whom information was shared
• Specific pieces of personal information collected about me

If you have sold or disclosed my personal information, please provide:
• Categories of information sold or disclosed
• Categories of third parties who received the information

sections.heading: Verification and Response Requirements
sections.content:
I understand that you may need to verify my identity before processing this request. I am prepared to provide additional documentation if necessary.

Per CCPA Section 1798.130, you must respond to this request within 45 days. If you need additional time, please notify me within the initial 45-day period.

Please send your response to: [PREFERRED_CONTACT_METHOD]

sections.heading: Legal References and Closing
sections.content:
This request is made under the authority of:
• California Civil Code Section 1798.100 et seq. (CCPA)
• California Code of Regulations Title 11, Division 1, Chapter 20

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your response within the legally required timeframe.

Sincerely,

[YOUR_SIGNATURE]
[YOUR_PRINTED_NAME]
[DATE]
